supersede_reason: The 2026-11-13 games were in progress or finished when this snapshot was taken, so the actionable slate is now 2026-11-14 .. 2026-11-17 (today + 3 days). The previous snapshot is kept in the repository unchanged as the audit trail for the 2026-11-13 calibration set.

primary_source.note: Week 5 (Nov 16 - Nov 22) of the official schedule page, retrieved 2026-11-14. The page renders each game's arena/city/state on three consecutive lines and the game id inside the printed [Preview] link target; both were copied verbatim, not reconstructed.

preview_url_pattern.verified_from: all 27 [Preview] links for this window were rendered verbatim on https://www.nba.com/schedule on 2026-11-14; no preview URL in this file is constructed by inference

provenance.counts_source: Game counts per date as displayed in the official NBA.com monthly calendar grid on https://www.nba.com/games (retrieved 2026-11-14): Nov 14 = 5 GAMES, Nov 15 = 9 GAMES, Nov 16 = 8 GAMES, Nov 17 = 5 GAMES. Matches this file exactly.
provenance.independent_reverification: The 22 rows for 2026-11-14 .. 2026-11-16 in this file were compared row-by-row against the same rows in slate_2026-11-13_to_11-16.json (captured 2026-11-13 22:33 UTC). All 22 match on date, time_et, teams, game_id, arena, city, state and broadcast: 0 mismatches. The 5 rows for 2026-11-17 are new.

pick_window.rule: Every game in this window had not tipped when the snapshot was taken (retrieval 2026-11-14 01:05 UTC = 2026-11-13 21:05 ET; the 2026-11-13 slate had already started). The sealed pre-registration therefore covers all 27 games in the window.

flags.issue: No market price data was retrievable in this session. NBA.com renders odds client-side behind a 'HIDE ODDS' toggle and the official picks.nba.com product exposes no lines. Every 'edge' figure on this site is therefore measured against our own baseline model, NOT against a vig-adjusted market price.
flags.action_required: Connect a licensed odds feed (see requirements R-101 and the Questions page, Q-04).

flags.issue: Win-loss records for Toronto and Washington were not visible in the retrieved NBA.com page text; third-party value only.

2026-27 game IDs are not monotonic with date: Nov 13 ran 0022600034-0022600042 (Emirates NBA Cup group play) and Nov 14 resumes at 0022600231. Any pipeline that guesses IDs by sequence will corrupt joins.
flags.action_required: Always read game_id from the official page; never infer it.

flags.issue: Game ids are not monotonic with tip time on 2026-11-17: the page prints 0022600257 (UTA @ LAC, 10:30 PM ET) before 0022600256 (CHA @ LAL, 11:00 PM ET), and 0022600254 (POR @ MIN, 8:00 PM ET) repeats the same matchup and venue as 0022600250 on 2026-11-16. Any ingest that sorts by id, or that infers a date from an id range, will mis-join these rows.
flags.action_required: Always key on the id read from the page and sort by the printed tip time. The repeated POR @ MIN pairing was independently confirmed on the official New York Knicks and Minnesota Timberwolves team schedule pages on 2026-11-14, so it is a property of the published schedule, not a one-off rendering artefact.

flags.issue: The official schedule page prints the LEAGUE PASS logo as the broadcast mark for a game that is available on League Pass. That is what the page says, but 'League Pass' is a viewing product, not a broadcaster, and it is recorded here exactly as printed.
flags.action_required: Do not treat the broadcast column as a national-TV indicator. If a real broadcast signal is wanted, read the game's own official page.
